name: The majority voted against [amendments](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debates/?id=2024-11-27.10.1) introduced by Goldstein MP [Zoe Daniel](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/goldstein/zoe_daniel) (Independent), which means it failed and will not be included in the bill. ### What do the amendments do? Ms Daniel [explained that](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debates/?id=2024-11-27.10.1): > *... what I've attempted to do with these amendments is to create an exemption framework in order that social media platforms may be able to bridge the gap between having to ban young people from being inside a platform and actually doing something about the way that they run their platforms.* ### Amendment text See the [House debates](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debate/?id=2024-11-27.10.2) for the text of the amendments.
